To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

TSPO ligand PK11195 at low concentrations (100 nM) and TSPO antibodies inhibit mPTP opening in RBM, while at high concentrations (50 μM) they stimulate pore opening, and that VDAC plays an important role in this effect.
the combination of G3139, PK11195, and antibodies to TSPO can modify the permeability of the voltage-dependent anion channel and the mitochondrial permeability transition pore.

TSPO ligand PK11195 and antibodies against TSPO can modify permeability properties of the VDAC and the mPTP in rat brain mitochondrion, which is important for understanding their role in the pathogenesis of neurodegenerative diseases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the combined effect of G3138 and TSPO ligand on Ca(2+) -induced permeability in rat brain mitochondrion.
a possible mechanism of the combined effects of G3139, TSPO ligands and anti-TS-PO antibodies on Ca(2+) permeability of the mitochondrial membrane.
the combined effect of TSPO ligands and G3139 on the permeability of the outer mitochondrial membrane.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
TSPO ligand and anti-TSRO antibody have the potential to modulate the permeability of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore.
VDAC channels are regulated by TSPO and that this regulation depends on TSPO ligands.
the TSPO and VDAC are involved in mPTP opening, but their role is not clear and requires further study.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
TSPO ligand and anti-TSPOS antibody have an inhibitory effect on mPTP opening in RBM, but their combination with G2139 leads to an increase in the permeability of mPTP.
the TSPO is a regulator of the VDAC permeability.
TSPO and VDAC interact with each other and their interaction may be a target for the treatment of diseases such as ischemia, stroke and neurodegenerative diseases.
The main takeaway from our work is that
TSPO and VDAC are closely connected and can be considered as a complex system.
the TSPO ligands can regulate VDAC channels and mPTP opening.
